svg.title: Produits et initiatives
svg.desc: KPay, FinTech: payments, transfers and savings groups with Mobile Money, 400+ active users. FormCam, EdTech SaaS: online training platform, 150+ users. Estuaire Emploi, mobile: job matching with real-time features, 1,750+ users. DSIE: engineering environment built on shared standards (DES). Original illustrations, not screenshots.
